Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes — a damaged item is handled differently from a normal return. Regular returns/exchanges aren’t accepted because items are final sale, but damaged or defective items are reviewed through our damage/warranty process. Was the damage caused during shipping, or is there a flaw with the product itself?
